parameters.name: EnableAudit
parameters.description:
是否重新创建ASM审计日志，取值：

- true：重新创建ASM审计日志

- false：不重新创建ASM审计日志

example.unifiedCli: aliyun servicemesh re-activate-audit --service-mesh-id c5bf9eb05c4424b89985d6536a8090000 --enable-audit true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun servicemesh ReActivateAudit --region cn-hangzhou --EnableAudit true --ServiceMeshId c5bf9eb05c4424b89985d6536a8090000
